I added a `--verbose` flag to `scripts/sync.sh`. I haven't run the script.

With `--verbose` as the first argument, the script prints each file path (such as `notes/a.txt`) after copying it. Without the flag it behaves as before. Usage is `scripts/sync.sh --verbose <dest>`.

The flag has to come before the destination. I wrote the check as an `if` rather than `[ ... ] && echo` so a non-verbose run doesn't exit with status 1 under `set -e`.
